sentences.en: But you know what's interesting is of all of that crushing information, what Michael heard was that David Wallace called him a nice guy.
sentences.zh: 但你知道有趣的是什么吗？在所有这些令人崩溃的信息中，迈克尔听到的却是戴维·华莱士夸他是个好人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And when Jan's lawyer says, wouldn't you agree with Ms. Levinson that the company exhibits a pattern of disrespect towards its employees?
sentences.zh: 当简的律师问，你难道不同意莱文森女士的观点，即公司对员工表现出一种不尊重的模式吗？

sentences.en: Michael says, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，绝对不同意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: He tanks her lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 他搞砸了她的诉讼。

sentences.en: There goes the $4 million.
sentences.zh: 那四百万美元就这样没了。

sentences.en: Now they're only going to be able to get Chinese food for dinner.
sentences.zh: 现在他们晚饭只能吃中餐了。

sentences.en: Oh, it's going to be a rough car ride home.
sentences.zh: 哦，回家的车程肯定很难熬。

sentences.en: But there is a very sweet scene where David Wallace goes up to Michael and is like, hey, I'm really sorry that you got drug into this.
sentences.zh: 但有一个非常温馨的场景，戴维·华莱士走到迈克尔身边说，嘿，真的很抱歉把你卷进这件事里。

sentences.en: I never wanted that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过这样。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, it's OK.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，没关系。

sentences.en: There is this moment, though, Jenna, where David is like the father Michael never had.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，那一刻，戴维就像是迈克尔从未拥有过的父亲。

sentences.en: And it looks like Michael is trying not to cry.
sentences.zh: 看起来迈克尔在努力不让自己哭出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Like when your dad comes up to you and says, I'm sorry, buddy.
sentences.zh: 就像你爸爸走过来对你说，对不起，伙计。

sentences.en: You OK?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: It's like that moment.
sentences.zh: 就像那一刻一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, for the record, I think you're a nice guy, too.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，郑重声明，我觉得你也是个好人。

sentences.en: It's a really sweet scene.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个非常温馨的场景。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: I have a great little behind the scenes trivia for you for that car ride home with Michael and Jan.
sentences.zh: 关于迈克尔和简回家的那段车程，我有一个很棒的幕后小花絮要告诉你。

sentences.en: Ooh, tell me.
sentences.zh: 哦，快告诉我。

sentences.en: Lester said that they had put lipstick cameras in the PT Cruiser for that car ride home.
sentences.zh: 莱斯特说，为了拍摄那段回家的车程，他们在PT漫步者车里装了微型摄像机。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And when they got the footage back, it was all just completely dark.
sentences.zh: 结果拿到素材一看，画面完全是一片漆黑。

sentences.en: The little light that they had put in the car, like on the dashboard where you couldn't see it,
sentences.zh: 他们原本在车里装了一个小灯，就在仪表盘上那种你看不到的地方，

sentences.en: it was going to illuminate Melora and Steve's faces.
sentences.zh: 本意是用来照亮梅洛拉和史蒂夫的脸。

sentences.en: I guess there was something wrong with the light.
sentences.zh: 我想那盏灯出了点问题。

sentences.en: And it clicked off.
sentences.zh: 然后它就关掉了。

sentences.en: And all the footage was dark.
sentences.zh: 所有的拍摄素材都是黑的。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: So the only footage they had of that car ride scene was from the follow car that was in front of them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时唯一拍到的那场车内戏素材，是来自前面那辆跟拍车的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they had a car in front of them filming them, and that's the only camera that worked.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有一辆车在前面拍他们，那是唯一正常工作的摄像机。

sentences.en: And I actually really like it.
sentences.zh: 而且我其实真的很喜欢这个效果。

sentences.en: And they talked about this a little bit in the commentary that it made it seem just way more real.
sentences.zh: 他们在评论音轨里也稍微提到了这一点，说这让画面看起来真实多了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That there was this distance between the camera and what was happening.
sentences.zh: 摄像机和正在发生的事情之间保持了这种距离感。

sentences.en: Kind of like what Randall talked about when he was on.
sentences.zh: 有点像兰德尔之前来的时候提到的那样。

sentences.en: The further away you were, the more intimate the moment feels to the viewer.
sentences.zh: 你离得越远，观众感受到的那一刻就越亲密。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: This episode ends with an epic ping pong match between Dwight and Mose, who has left Shroop Farms,
sentences.zh: 这一集以德怀特和莫斯之间一场史诗般的乒乓球赛结束，莫斯应该是第一次离开施鲁特农场。

sentences.en: I believe, for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样，这是他第一次离开。

sentences.en: We're seeing him off the farm.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他离开了农场。

sentences.en: They are playing ping pong in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 他们在仓库里打乒乓球。

sentences.en: It's clearly after hours.
sentences.zh: 显然已经下班了。

sentences.en: It's dark.
sentences.zh: 天很黑。

sentences.en: Not all the lights are on.
sentences.zh: 灯没有全开。

sentences.en: And they are amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且他们打得太棒了。

sentences.en: We had a fan question, Angela, from Ben S., Keith N., Bethany M., and Kai B.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们有一个来自本·S、基思·N、贝瑟尼·M和凯·B的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Were Rain and Mike Schur actually playing ping pong in this scene?
sentences.zh: 雷恩和迈克·舒尔在这一幕里是真的在打乒乓球吗？

sentences.en: Are they that good?
sentences.zh: 他们真的有那么厉害吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: This was all CGI.
sentences.zh: 这全是电脑特效。

sentences.en: I think by this time, they had learned how hard it was to actually film actors playing ping pong.
sentences.zh: 我想到了这个时候，他们已经意识到拍摄演员打乒乓球有多难了。

sentences.en: So that was CGI.
sentences.zh: 所以那是电脑特效。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Those guys were just moving their arms, and they put the ball in digitally in poSt.
sentences.zh: 那些家伙只是在挥动手臂，球是后期数字合成进去的。

sentences.en: Before we wrap up this episode, you guys, there is a deleted scene that is delicious.
sentences.zh: 在结束这一集之前，各位，有一个非常精彩的删减片段。

sentences.zh: 轮到克里德在邓德·米夫林的会议室里和吉姆练习乒乓球了。

sentences.en: And Creed's like, yeah, I played.
sentences.zh: 克里德说，好啊，我打过。

sentences.en: I learned to play in Cambodia.
sentences.zh: 我是在柬埔寨学会打球的。

sentences.en: Jim's like, great.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，太好了。

sentences.en: They start playing.
sentences.zh: 他们开始打了。

sentences.en: Creed loses a point right out of the gate.
sentences.zh: 克里德一上来就丢了一分。

sentences.en: Starts taking off his shirt.
sentences.zh: 开始脱衬衫。

sentences.en: Jim's like, hold up.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，等等。

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 你在干什么？

sentences.en: And Creed's like, but this isn't strip pong?
sentences.zh: 克里德说，这不是脱衣乒乓球吗？

sentences.en: And Jim's like, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Creed's like, okay.
sentences.zh: 克里德说，好吧。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Creed thought when you play ping pong, you have to strip when you lose a point.
sentences.zh: 克里德以为打乒乓球输了一分就得脱衣服。

sentences.en: Oh, that's funny.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I wish that stayed in.
sentences.zh: 真希望那段没被删掉。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我也这么想。

sentences.en: That's what she said.
sentences.zh: 她刚才就是这么说的。

sentences.en: Guys, that is the deposition.
sentences.zh: 各位，那就是证词陈述。

sentences.zh: 希望下周你们能来参加我们的炖小牛膝晚餐派对。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.zh: 下周是晚餐派对。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我的天呐。

sentences.zh: 我们到了，珍娜。

sentences.en: We'll show up for it, guys.
sentences.zh: 我们会去的，伙计们。

sentences.zh: 我等不及了。
